desc: Read input efficiently and build adjacency lists for original and reversed edges.
Build adjacency list for original directed edges.
Model state as (v, parity) where parity 0=original orientation, 1=reversed.
Define transitions: (v, 0) -> (u, 0) cost 1 for each original edge v->u; (v, 1) -> (u, 1) cost 1 for each original edge u->v; toggle (v, 0)<->(v, 1) cost X.
Run Dijkstra on the 2N state graph starting from (1, 0).
Output the answer as a 64-bit integer.
